Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The first mistake was to anchor the whole search on a single fund, FEMKX, and then repeatedly chase the wrong path instead of properly identifying the full set of Fidelity no-transaction-fee international emerging markets funds and comparing their May 2019 to May 2024 performance. The final answer was therefore unsupported: it named only FEMKX without establishing that it was the lowest-increase fund.
